name: Les Auxerrois
notes: Sector to the right of the Grotte aux Filles ('Girls' Cave', route 93).
This sector is quite shady, with routes at accessible grades that are fairly short overall.
Still, stay alert to the rock quality, which can sometimes be poor, even if it is fairly compact overall.
routes: Consistent and athletic. Very vertical corner with some quite surprising Buoux-style pockets. A classic at the grade.
Start up 72, then follow the pillar. Technical climbing on an arête. Surprising.
Nicely continuous. Rising traverse; finish either in the corner of Le Singe (route 70) or in Coquille's Club (route 71). Traverses were in fashion in the '80s.
Bouldery. The rock on the slab is very compact. Technical and demanding on the feet.
Consistent. Very nice route on decent holds that needs speed and determination. Quite pumpy overall.
A nice journey up a crack. Big moves on good holds. Classy at the grade.
Complex — make sure to plan the line ahead. Very fun.
Journey to the End of the Surbac
Quite bouldery. Start on rock sculpted by water droplets; fun roof and mantel. Takes determination for the mantel.
Surprising but very cool route at the grade.
Variant of route 80, less physical but more technical and on slab. Plenty of smearing. Pretty, fun route.
Inconsistent. Getting into the corner is the crux. Fun finish.
Cracked slabs broken up by small ledges. Fun at the grade.
Start up L'Ondulée to reach a wide crack on the left. Original.
Very nice route with varied styles. A must-do.
Jamming technique to the fore… the art of the lock.
One slightly bouldery move. Route often overgrown with vegetation.
Nice slab route. Unstable flake at the top — don't yank on it like an ox; go round it on the left.
Short, intense route on slightly dubious rock.
Short, punchy route that needs real determination.
Un seul ennui : bras et zézettes ramollissent
Only One Problem: Arms and Willies Go Soft
Original line, big jugs and a traverse under a roof. Holds a bit dirty. Disconcerting route overall.
Route on surprising rock. Technical climbing.
Trapco, mate pas trop les filles
Trapco, Don't Ogle the Girls Too Much
Big traverse with an original line. Rope drag possible. Climbing it as a second is recommended to retrieve the quickdraws.
